tools.name: get_finops_overview
tools.title: FinOps overview
tools.description: Headline Foundry spend and usage: billed spend month to date, month-end forecast, tokens and requests in the last 24 hours, cost controls needing attention, budgets, highest quota use, and the top projects, agents and models by spend. Billed cost lags usage by 8–24 hours; token counts are near real time.

tools.name: upsert_cost_control
tools.title: Create or update a cost control
tools.description: Create or replace a Foundry cost control that alerts (Event Grid) or blocks requests when spending (USD) or tokens reach a threshold. Blocked requests get HTTP 429 with x-ms-budget-cause: budget_exceeded. Takes effect within about 15 minutes. The budget type can't be changed after creation.

project.description: Create the cost control inside this project; omit for the Foundry resource.

filters.description: Filter name → list of names. Keys: project, deployment, agent, sessionId, tokenType (input/output). An agent filter needs exactly one project.
